sqa_templates.sqa: SELECT <NAME_ENTITY> FROM <REFERENCE> ORDER BY <VAL_QUANTITY> DESC LIMIT :top_k;
sqa_templates.intent: Find the top-ranked entities by quantity.
Retrieve entities belonging to a specific category or topic.

sqa_templates.sqa: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM <REFERENCE> WHERE <TIME_EVENT> >= :start_date AND <TIME_EVENT> < :end_date;
sqa_templates.intent: Count records within a specified time window.

sqa_templates.sqa: SELECT <CATEGORY_TOPIC>, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM <REFERENCE> GROUP BY <CATEGORY_TOPIC> ORDER BY record_count DESC;
sqa_templates.intent: Analyze distribution of records across categories.
Retrieve entity name and description by external identifier.
